(1) in terms of neointima proliferation the regular DES (Prollim® and Alex) obtained similar results and (2) in BiOSS subgroup more pronounced response from vessel wall was found.

In summary, our research is concerned with
a comparative evaluation of the efficacy of three different DES, which are characterized by a biodegradable coating with a similar drug concentration and the same drug.
the assessment of the effectiveness and safety of three drug-eluting biodegradable polymer-based sirolimus-eluting stents with various stent platforms.
the assessment of three DES produced by the same manufacturer, with the same biolimus-eluting polymer but different stent platforms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the choice of the stent platform is of great importance in the process of neointima proliferation.
the stent platform is a more important factor in determining the neointima proliferation than the polymer or the drug.
the stent platform and strut thickness are more important than the polymer type in the process of neointima formation after sirolimus-eluting stents implantation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of biodegradable polymer in DES is a good option for the treatment of patients with coronary artery disease.
regular DES are characterized by a lower neointima proliferation than biodegradable stents, which is associated with a higher late lumen loss and higher neointima burden and volume.
the choice of a stent with the best results in the long-term follow-up is still a matter of discussion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of the stent platform may be crucial in terms of the neointima formation.
the choice of the DES platform is important for clinical outcomes.

the choice of a particular stent should be made on an individual basis, taking into consideration patient's needs, the size of the vessel, the length of the stenosis and the presence of calcifications.
